task: U09 rare inherited Chinese summary verification
mode: read-only linguistic verification; no repository or product-status edits
scope: W000422 husband; W000816 special; W002311 fairly; W004786 shatter. Verify inherited Chinese summary senses, not the whole cards or verbForms.
decisionRules: A missing modern learner-dictionary entry does not prove an old or specialized sense wrong.
Lexical existence, Chinese translation fidelity, source provenance, and unit-example applicability are different claims.
Direct publisher entries are stronger than search-index snippets. Unattributed Chinese aggregators are provenance leads only.
Keep unsupported original pairings pending; do not invent mappings or silently delete them.
Dictionary register labels may differ; report the difference rather than invent a consensus.

certainCorrections: husband final 節儉 should be explicitly separated as a transitive resource-conservation verb, while the noun headword remains n.
shatter 碎片 is a noun, usually plural shatters, and should be labeled separately from the v. headword.
confirmedRetentions: All four fairly glosses, including 美觀地 and 清楚地.
husband property manager and frugal person, with British/archaic qualifications as described.
special noun train, newspaper extra, and special thing.
shatter ordinary breaking and figurative hope-destruction; plant shedding is a real verb family.
pendingExactOriginalMappings: shatter 落葉 if inherited as a noun
summary.importantNegativeConclusion: Do not report that special 專輯 or shatter 噴灑 do not exist merely because familiar learner senses differ. Real adjacent/historical senses make those conclusions unjustified.

items.lexicalReviewConclusion: All four semantic families are supported. The final gloss is a separate transitive verb sense, not a noun meaning the abstract quality of thrift.

senses.qualificationsOrUncertainty: COBUILD 將此動詞標 literary。本卡詞頭 n. 不改，摘要明示另有動詞用法。

非尋常、不同於一般的形容詞義支持特殊的。

senses.qualificationsOrUncertainty: MW 本義未標 archaic 或 obsolete。可說此義非本句常見程度副詞義，不可未據此自行標廢語。

程度副詞 rather/moderately，可譯相當地。

senses.qualificationsOrUncertainty: MW 本義沒有古語標籤；不要因常用義只有公平／相當就刪掉本義。

items.before: 碎片；粉碎；落葉；噴灑；（本單元動詞）使粉碎／震碎；粉碎希望
items.afterCandidate: 碎片（名詞，通常用複數）；粉碎；落葉；噴灑；（本單元動詞）使粉碎／震碎；粉碎希望
items.candidateType: minimal certain POS clarification only; ambiguous inherited 落葉 and 噴灑 retained without guessing their original intended POS
items.optionalClarifiedCandidate: （本單元動詞）使粉碎／震碎；粉碎希望；（亦有動詞義）粉碎；（葉、花瓣或果實）脫落；（另有名詞用法，通常用複數）碎片；（原譯所指待確認）落葉；噴灑
items.optionalClarifiedCandidateCaution: This educational presentation is intentionally explicit but duplicates the unresolved 落葉 string. Do not deploy it as a clean replacement without editorial review. The primary afterCandidate is the safe minimum.
items.lexicalReviewConclusion: Fragments, breaking, plant shedding, and historical scatter/sprinkle senses exist. The inherited four-gloss sequence is found elsewhere as a noun list, so do not automatically reinterpret its 落葉 or 噴灑 as verbs. Preserve those exact Chinese mappings pending original-source evidence.

senses.finding: 明確是名詞碎片／碎屑，多用複數。
senses.qualificationsOrUncertainty: Collins British English 標 obsolete or dialect；MW/AHD 只明示常用複數，未統一標古語。這個名詞義不能藉詞頭 v. 自動抹掉。
senses.recommendedAction: retain and label noun, usually plural

senses.finding: 動詞可指粉碎／變碎，名詞也可指粉碎的動作或已破碎的狀態。
senses.qualificationsOrUncertainty: 原清單可能從名詞摘要而來，不宜沒有來源就把第一個粉碎強制指派給單一詞性。
senses.recommendedAction: retain; distinguish noun act/state if the source schema is later recovered

senses.partOfSpeech: intransitive shedding confirmed; original nominal interpretation unconfirmed
senses.finding: 植物落葉／掉花瓣／落果的動詞義確有；農業穀粒因過熟散落也有歷史詞典支持。
senses.qualificationsOrUncertainty: 若原落葉指落葉動作，語義可成立；若指地上的一片落葉，現有可靠來源未核實這個名詞義。搜尋同序摘要竟標 n.，故保留詞性／來源疑點，不能宣稱整個原義已核真。
senses.recommendedAction: preserve pending original POS; may separately add the supported 動詞：（葉等）脫落 sense if desired

senses.partOfSpeech: noun fragments spray; historical dialect verb scatter/sprinkle and noun sprinkling
senses.finding: AHD 有名詞飛散的一堆碎片；肯特歷史方言有灑散、零星降雨的動名詞，Wiltshire 有撒胡椒的動詞例。
senses.qualificationsOrUncertainty: spray of fragments 不是泛指噴液動作；sprinkle 也不必有噴射。上述義不能自動證明原中文噴灑的詞性或範圍。未核到可靠英漢原條目，不能直接刪除或認證為現代普通噴灑。
senses.recommendedAction: preserve pending; evidence-backed alternatives are 飛散的一堆碎片（名詞） or 灑／撒（歷史方言動詞）, chosen only after intended sense is established

senses.finding: 使物體碎成很多小片的動詞義；震碎是導致破碎的具體方式。
senses.qualificationsOrUncertainty: 本次僅核詞義，不重新認證例句／圖片。

senses.finding: 希望、夢想、信念被徹底破壞的比喻動詞用法。

pending.reason: 已證植物脫落的動詞，但原四義摘要有名詞清單的來源線索；尚不能核實落下的葉片／落葉名詞義。
pending.nextEvidenceNeeded: 原始英漢條目，特別是 n. 與 vi. 的分界，或可證明 noun shatter 指 fallen leaves 的權威詞典義項。

pending.reason: 相關名詞碎片飛散及歷史方言灑散義已證；原譯究竟是哪一義、是否錯置詞性仍未明。
pending.nextEvidenceNeeded: 原始英漢條目的噴灑對應英義、詞性和地域／時代標記。

sources.title: Merriam-Webster: shatter

shortExactExcerpts.text: to drop off parts (such as leaves, petals, or fruit)
to cause to drop or be dispersed

sources.notes: The leaf sense is verbal shedding, not automatically a fallen-leaf object noun. MW also records a nominal act/state of shattering. These excerpts together contain 24 English words.

sources.title: Collins English Dictionary / COBUILD: shatter

shortExactExcerpts.text: to break or be broken into many small pieces

sources.notes: COBUILD explicitly discusses destroying dreams, hopes and beliefs. Collins qualifies the fragment noun more strongly than MW/AHD, which mainly note plural usage. Do not assert unanimous modern frequency or a uniform archaic label.

sources.title: American Heritage Dictionary 5th edition: shatter

shortExactExcerpts.text: A scattering collection or spray of fragments

sources.notes: The displayed spray is a noun and explicitly consists of fragments. It does not establish a generic verb meaning to spray liquid. Use the publisher page for POS: Wordnik incorrectly displayed several clearly transitive AHD definitions under intransitive verb.

sources.title: Wordnik quoting The Century Dictionary: shatter
sources.sourceStrength: B+: named historical dictionary reproduced by aggregator

shortExactExcerpts.text: Of cereals, to scatter the grain on account of overripeness.

sources.notes: Provides agricultural grain-shedding context. Wordnik omits POS metadata in the Century entries, so do not rely on it alone for transitivity. MW supplies unambiguous vi/vt labels for the shedding family.

sources.title: Kent Archaeological Society: transcription of A Dictionary of the Kentish Dialect and Provincialisms (1888)

sources.notes: Historical Kent dialect, not an unrestricted contemporary standard-English spray sense. sources.title: Dartnell and Goddard, A Glossary of Words Used in the County of Wiltshire (1893), Addenda p. 201
